tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Default surface: panels, toolbar, dialogs, cards. Ground for `color-text`, `color-text-secondary`, `color-icon`.

tokens.name: color-bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Recessed surface: tab bar, home sidebar, field fills, quiet hover fills.

tokens.name: color-bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Stronger fill for pressed segments and avatars without a colour.

tokens.name: color-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, icon buttons and list items on `color-bg`.

tokens.name: color-bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed / active fill for icon buttons and segments.

tokens.name: color-bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows (layers, pages) and the active segment. Text stays `color-text`.

tokens.name: color-bg-selected-secondary
tokens.usage: Children of a selected layer in the layers list.

tokens.name: color-bg-selected-strong
tokens.usage: Strong selection fill (selected file card outline, rail active dot).

tokens.name: color-bg-brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions (Share, Present, Create), focus rings, canvas selection. Text on it: `color-text-onbrand`.

tokens.name: color-bg-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `color-bg-brand` fills.

tokens.name: color-bg-component
tokens.usage: Component and instance identity: canvas outlines and component frame labels on the canvas. As a mark on `color-bg` it is 4.5:1 (light) but 2.6:1 (dark); in dark panels use `color-text-component` for text.

tokens.name: color-bg-component-selected
tokens.usage: Selected component or instance row in the layers list.

tokens.name: color-bg-menu
tokens.usage: Context menus and quick-action surfaces (always dark). Text: `color-text-menu`.

tokens.name: color-bg-menu-hover
tokens.usage: Highlighted menu item. Text stays `color-text-menu` (3.0:1 light, 3.5:1 dark: below AA for small text, as in the source).

tokens.name: color-bg-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips (always dark).

tokens.name: color-bg-toolbar
tokens.usage: Floating toolbar surface.

tokens.name: color-bg-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills and the error-red canvas accent.

tokens.name: color-bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Infinite canvas behind frames; default page background.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on `color-bg` and `color-bg-secondary`.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, section titles and metadata on `color-bg` and `color-bg-secondary`. Contrast: 4.0:1 (light) and 7.6:1 (dark) on `color-bg`; below AA 4.5:1 in light, so never use it for text the user must read to act.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and hints on `color-bg`. Contrast 2.1:1 (light) and 3.6:1 (dark): decorative only, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: color-text-brand
tokens.usage: Links and brand-coloured text on `color-bg`. Contrast 4.2:1 (light, just under AA for small text) and 7.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: color-text-onbrand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `color-bg-brand`, `color-bg-menu-hover` and `color-bg-danger`. On brand blue: 3.0:1 (light) and 3.5:1 (dark), below AA for small text; the source keeps it, so keep labels on blue short and at weight 550.

tokens.name: color-text-component
tokens.usage: Component and instance names in the layers list and properties panel, on `color-bg` (5.7:1 light, 7.2:1 dark) and `color-bg-component-selected`.

tokens.name: color-text-menu
tokens.usage: Text in menus and tooltips on `color-bg-menu` / `color-bg-tooltip`.

tokens.name: color-text-menu-secondary
tokens.usage: Shortcuts and secondary text inside menus.

tokens.name: color-text-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive labels (Delete forever, errors) on `color-bg`: 4.6:1 (light), 7.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: color-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon colour on `color-bg`.

tokens.name: color-icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Icons in fields, quiet icon buttons and layer type icons.

tokens.name: color-icon-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled icons and hidden-layer icons.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and sections, field and card outlines.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: High-emphasis outline (focused or active controls).

tokens.name: color-border-selected
tokens.usage: Selected and focused outlines: fields in focus, selected file cards, drop targets. Against `color-bg`: 3.0:1 (light) and 3.9:1 (dark), right at the 3:1 floor for focus indicators.

tokens.name: color-border-menu
tokens.usage: Separators inside menus on `color-bg-menu`.

tokens.name: color-bordertranslucent
tokens.usage: Hairline on top of images and swatches (works on any fill).

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default UI text: field values, layer names, menu items, panel copy.

styles.name: body-medium-strong
styles.usage: Section titles in the properties panel, selected layer names, button labels.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Longer copy: dialogs, empty states, agent messages, home screen text.
styles.sample: Files are stored locally in this browser.

styles.name: body-large-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in large copy: file titles, dialog actions.

styles.name: heading-small
styles.usage: Panel and dialog headings at the small size.

styles.name: heading-medium
styles.usage: Page-level headings: home sections, variables view title.

styles.name: heading-large
styles.usage: The largest UI heading: home and empty-state titles.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Generated CSS and SVG in Dev Mode, hex values in the inspector.

spacing.note: The code writes these dimensions as literal values; the names here are the design system's, the values are exactly the code's.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Width of the properties panel and the docked left panel column (a real `--panel-w` custom property).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation rail.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the desktop tab bar and the presenter bar.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Height of layer, page and paint rows and of toolbar tool buttons.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of number fields, selects, segmented controls and icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs, segments and stacked rail items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between fields in a tight row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside tabs, chips and file metadata.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The most common gap: paired fields (X/Y, W/H), toolbar groups, card grids, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between home sections and between large cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of panel sections and section headers.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Colour swatches and gradient stops.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Small parts: badges, chips, tab close buttons, toolbar carets, the colour field.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Default control radius (a real `--radius` custom property): fields, buttons, selects, segments, icon buttons, layer and page rows.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Tabs, toolbar tools, mode switch, sliders, cards inside panels.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: File cards and their thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-13
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: toolbar, menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, comment pins and other circles.

tokens.name: shadow-elevation
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and file cards on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar
tokens.usage: The floating toolbar over the canvas.
